contamination.note: Not blind. The geometry came from `harness ocr lines --store mz`, which emits CONTENT alongside the boxes, so the recognizer's text was on screen before the sheets were read. The reading below is off the raster and diverges from it at every place that mattered: `al` -> `a¹`, `dl` -> `d¹`, `cl` -> `c¹`, `6` -> italic `b`, and two specks it silently dropped are declared here rather than in the text. mz/ocr/ remains an independent witness by inode for the span diff (`ocr review 1-283 --spans --store mz`).

page.note: Printed folio 223, part 1. Pure English prose — not one Tier-1 form on the page, so §5's checklist has no subject here and no line carries a `resolved` field for notation. The only non-ASCII characters are the curly apostrophe on line 15 and the three superscript ones. Figures 152, 153 and 154 sit in the text block; their captions are FigDesc and live in data/readings.md, not here. `harness ocr gaps` reports zero bands against gt/fig/chukchi-1-283.xml.
page.footnotes: No footnotes on this page. The three ¹ are figure sub-labels (Fig. 155, a¹ / b, d¹ / c¹), not note markers — §2.10's counting invariants are satisfied incidentally (a continuous run of one value, occurring three times) but they are not measuring anything here.
